answer: An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 4 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Because the inlet count is verified against the atlas text itself, the opal audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 181 aliases thus means producing 181 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. That is 11 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
